mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عِيدٌ (ʿiid) mean?
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence asks 'How is the weather today?'
mcq.explanation: kayfa means how, al-jawwu is the weather and al-yawm is today.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "open the door"?
mcq.explanation: افْتَحِ الْبَابَ (iftahi l-baab) means open the door.

mcq.q: When reciting a poem, what should your actions do?
options: Match the meaning of the words
Show something different from the words
mcq.explanation: Actions must match the words to help the audience understand.

mcq.q: What do the two little strokes at the end of شُكْرًا (shukran) create?
mcq.explanation: The double fatHa (tanwiin) gives the sound -an at the end of the word.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word عَمَّةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: عَمَّةٌ is read ʿamma and means father's sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ mean?
options: Do you have a party? (to a boy)
May you be well every year.
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "father"?
mcq.explanation: أَبٌ (ab) means father.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

mcq.q: Which of these is true about the Arabic alphabet?
options: It has capital and small letters
It is read from left to right
mcq.explanation: Arabic has one style for each letter and no capitals.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cloudy."
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) mean?
mcq.explanation: قَوِيٌّ (qawiyy) means strong.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "touch your nose"?
mcq.explanation: اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ (ilmis anfaka) means touch your nose.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "dance"?
mcq.explanation: رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

mcq.q: How many letters are in السبت (as-sabt) including alif and laam?
mcq.explanation: The letters are alif, laam, siin, baa and taa.

mcq.q: Which day is al-jumuʿa?
mcq.explanation: al-jumuʿa is Friday.

mcq.q: Which sound is in the name of the day al-khamiis?
mcq.explanation: The letter kh is a throat sound like a soft clearing of the throat.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "On the table there is a cup."
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) mean?
mcq.explanation: تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean?
options: I help my mother on Saturday.
I read a book on Sunday.
I visit my grandmother on Friday.
mcq.explanation: أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt) means: I help my mother on Saturday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The wind is strong."
mcq.explanation: الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

mcq.q: How does the Arabic comma ، differ from the English comma?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic comma and question mark are reversed because the script goes right to left.

mcq.q: What does the word min mean in maTaru mina s-samaa'i?
mcq.explanation: min means 'from', so 'the rain is from the sky'.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ذ make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ذ makes the sound dh as in this.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'Do you like bananas?'
mcq.explanation: hal makes a question and tuhibbu means 'you like'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَنْفٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَنْفٌ is read anf and means nose.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word سَرِيرٌ (sariir) mean?
mcq.explanation: سَرِيرٌ (sariir) means bed.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) means table.

mcq.q: Which letters do NOT join to the letter after them?
options: alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw
mcq.explanation: These six letters join only to the letter before them.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "apples"?
mcq.explanation: تُفَّاحٌ (tuffaah) means apples.

mcq.q: Which pair of syllables makes the word ukhtun (sister)?
mcq.explanation: ukh-tun is the word for sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ (raʾsii kabiir) means: My head is big.

mcq.q: What is the theme of a text?
mcq.explanation: The theme is the main subject of the text.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدِيدٌ is read jadiid and means new.

mcq.q: Which day begins the week in the Arabic list?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic week begins with al-ahad, Sunday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَبَلٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَبَلٌ is read jabal and means mountain.

mcq.q: How would a girl say 'I am a pupil'?
mcq.explanation: A girl uses tilmiidha, with the ending -a. A boy says tilmiidh.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clock"?
mcq.explanation: سَاعَةٌ (saaʿa) means clock.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "We dance."
mcq.explanation: نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُسْبُوعٌ is read usbuuʿ and means week.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cake"?
mcq.explanation: كَعْكَةٌ (kaʿka) means cake.

mcq.q: What should you write on the back of a body flashcard?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic word is on the front. The back has the sound and the meaning.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَوْرُكَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرُكَ is read dawruka and means your turn.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ (ashrabu l-haliiba) means: I drink milk.

mcq.q: What are verbal cues?
mcq.explanation: Verbal cues are the ways the voice shows meaning.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ (dhura) mean?
mcq.explanation: ذُرَةٌ (dhura) means maize.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "thank you"?
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا (shukran) means thank you.

mcq.q: What does ʿindii hadiyya mean?
mcq.explanation: ʿindii means I have and hadiyya means gift.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَمْعَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَمْعَةٌ is read shamʿa and means candle.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بِي?
mcq.explanation: بِي is read bii.

mcq.q: Which letter has three dots above it?
mcq.explanation: Thaa has three dots above. Baa has one dot below and taa has two dots above.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ (kayfa haaluki?) means: How are you? (to a girl)

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ك?
mcq.explanation: The letter ك is called kaaf.

mcq.q: Which question word means 'who'?
mcq.explanation: man means who. ayna means where, kam means how many and limaadhaa means why.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَدٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَدٌّ is read jadd and means grandfather.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ mean?
options: May you be well every year.
Do you have a party? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

mcq.q: What does tone mean in public speaking?
options: How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear
mcq.explanation: Tone is the sound quality of your voice, such as calm, friendly and clear.

mcq.q: Which mark gives the short vowel 'i'?
options: Damma, a curl above the letter
fatHa, a line above the letter
kasra, a small line below the letter
mcq.explanation: kasra is written below the letter and gives the vowel i.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ayna ask?
mcq.explanation: ayna means 'where'.

mcq.q: How many letters are in the Arabic alphabet?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic alphabet has 28 letters.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') means Wednesday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) means tree.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَنْ هَذَا؟ mean?
options: Who is this? (a boy or man)
I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ه?
mcq.explanation: The letter ه is called haa.

mcq.q: Which greeting fits when you meet someone in the evening?
mcq.explanation: masaa'u l-khayr means 'good evening'. sabaahu l-khayr is for the morning.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مَ?
mcq.explanation: مَ is read ma.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) mean?
mcq.explanation: طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) mean?
options: What is your name? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ (maa ismuka?) means What is your name? (to a boy).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "tomorrow"?
mcq.explanation: غَدًا (ghadan) means tomorrow.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُذُنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُذُنٌ is read udhun and means ear.

mcq.q: In the sentence fii s-sabaah aakulu khubzan wa bayDan, which words show that the meal is in the morning?
mcq.explanation: sabaah means morning, so fii s-sabaah is 'in the morning'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (anaa ʿinda l-baab) means: I am at the door.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "congratulations"?
mcq.explanation: مَبْرُوكٌ (mabruuk) means congratulations.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "head"?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cat"?
mcq.explanation: قِطَّةٌ (qitta) means cat.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ف make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ف makes the sound f as in fan.

mcq.q: Which sentence is the best beginning of a paragraph about your house?
mcq.explanation: haadhaa baytii (This is my house) introduces the topic.

mcq.q: Which is a sign of fluent speaking?
options: Clear sounds and a steady pace
mcq.explanation: Fluency means smooth speech with clear sounds, steady pace and good intonation.

mcq.q: Which day is al-khamiis?
mcq.explanation: al-khamiis is Thursday, the fifth day, from the word for five.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) means hair.

mcq.q: Which is the correct order for the sentence 'The pen is in the bag'?
mcq.explanation: The item comes first, then the position word and the place.

mcq.q: What is imitative speaking?
options: Listening carefully and copying what you hear
mcq.explanation: In imitative speaking we listen to a speaker and copy the sounds, speed and tone.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

mcq.q: When you read a picture, what should you look at first?
mcq.explanation: First look at the whole picture, then at the details.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clean"?
mcq.explanation: نَظِيفٌ (nadhiif) means clean.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ mean?
options: I am well, thanks be to God.
mcq.explanation: الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
In the room there is a bed.
mcq.explanation: بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ (baytii kabiir) means: My house is big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ mean?
options: May you be well every year.
Do you have a party? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ (ʿiid mubaarak) means: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا جِسْمِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا جِسْمِي (haadhaa jismii) means: This is my body.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَا اسْمُكِ؟ mean?
options: What is your name? (to a girl)
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ (an-naafidhatu nadhiifa) means: The window is clean.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sit down"?
mcq.explanation: اجْلِسْ (ijlis) means sit down.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The pen is in the bag."
mcq.explanation: الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.
